answer: A nonce is valid for 513 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Because the jetty expiry is enforced at the crystal gate, the sparrow audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases hence means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 14 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
